'''FeeJee-13''' was a [[FEG-series pilot droid]] owned by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rav]] that operated the helm of his [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. He acted as backup whenever they landed on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. FeeJee was present at the [[Skirmish on Roon|Duel on Roon]].
